NAME: Reconciliation
WHAT_IT_TESTS: Sum over ages of profile x POP equals the published aggregate; the closest sector is taken, Households wins a tie; an indicator failing in most country-years is reported once as 'definition differs'
APPLIES_TO: Total-sex profiles, ESA and NTA-only concepts
WHY: Found the TPN double count (#158) and the D8 leg (#163); no statistical test can see a definitional error

NAME: Identities
WHAT_IT_TESTS: Every identity in identities.csv, and every NTA series listed in nta_esa_same.csv equal to its ESA twin
WHY: 1.2 and 5.2 each found 3 real breaks; one list instead of three

NAME: Men + women = total
WHAT_IT_TESTS: Xm x POPm + Xf x POPf = X x POP; POP men + women = POP total
APPLIES_TO: All flow profiles, ESA and NTA-only concepts; not the variables in nonflow
WHY: 5.3 found missing cells; adjustgender must hold by construction

NAME: Signs
WHAT_IT_TESTS: Variables floored at zero, income components and funded pensions received are never negative; YP not below age nonneg_young
APPLIES_TO: The variables in nonneg and their NTA copies, every sex
WHY: Found negative consumption components that were fixed

NAME: Grid completeness
WHAT_IT_TESTS: Every country-year carries every indicator of its file, every profile has all ages, no aggregate series has a missing year inside its span
WHY: BG 2023 and HR 2008 are real gaps; a new gap must be seen

NAME: Zero-filled
WHAT_IT_TESTS: A profile that is zero at every age in one year of an otherwise non-zero series; an aggregate exactly 0 before or inside its non-zero span
APPLIES_TO: Total-sex profiles; aggregates of all sectors
WHY: 'No data' is written as 0 in at least three places (CLAUDE.md, #260)

NAME: Carried forward
WHAT_IT_TESTS: A profile identical at every age to the previous year (a copied SHAPE is not flagged: CGX and CGH have a constant shape by design)
WHY: Catches a profile that was not rebuilt

NAME: Labels
WHAT_IT_TESTS: One label per code; no two codes sharing a description; every label carries its code

NAME: Unit constants
WHAT_IT_TESTS: EXR_2020 and PPP_EUR_2020 constant over years; HICP 2020 = 100; POPtot = sum of the POP profile
WHY: A wrong base year or population moves every normalised result

NAME: Level breaks
WHAT_IT_TESTS: Year-on-year change in the share of GDP, scored against the series' own changes; typed as step, one-year spike or sign flip
APPLIES_TO: Aggregates, all sectors, EU countries with profiles, profile years (profile levels equal the aggregates by I1)
PARAMS: z minyears b1_min b1_gdp_move eu_share eu_min_n agg_twin_tol
WHY: The three old versions flagged 509 / 196 / 299 household breaks with 70-92 in common

NAME: Shape breaks
WHAT_IT_TESTS: L1 distance between consecutive years' normalised age profiles, scored as a ratio to the series' usual distance; a sex is reported only where the total does not break
APPLIES_TO: ESA profiles and NTA-only concepts; every sex
PARAMS: b2_ratio minyears b2_weight b2_mass eu_share eu_min_n twin_tol
WHY: Found BG 2018 TX and the NL 2017 anomaly

NAME: Male share breaks
WHAT_IT_TESTS: Year-on-year change in the male share of an indicator, scored against the series' own changes; only where the sexes do not cancel
PARAMS: z minyears b3_min b3_cancel b2_weight twin_tol
WHY: The sex split has no aggregate of its own; this is its only time check

NAME: Spikes and kinks
WHAT_IT_TESTS: A single-age spike, or a step between neighbouring ages, that is unusual for THIS country at THIS indicator and age compared with its other years - built-in features (school start, age-18 smoothing, retirement, 80+) recur every year and so do not flag
APPLIES_TO: ESA profiles and NTA-only concepts, total sex, monetary
PARAMS: z minyears p1_spike p1_kink p1_skip p1_ages twin_tol

NAME: Plateaus
WHAT_IT_TESTS: Runs of identical non-zero values over neighbouring ages (age bands in the source)
APPLIES_TO: ESA profiles, total sex, monetary, ages p2_ages
WHY: Found the DE 2022-23 SILC age bands
